english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing someone whose behaviour or words are hypocritical.
Use this when “hollow” means insincere or specious, including an insincere promise or claim rather than something merely lacking substance.

examples.english: He says he supports environmental protection, but he drives a large-engine car all the time; he’s really hypocritical.
examples.traditional: 佢表面話支持環保，自己就成日揸大排量車，真係好虛偽。

examples.english: His hollow promises were so insincere that I never believed them.
examples.traditional: 佢嗰啲承諾咁虛偽，我一早就唔信。
